ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular high-intensity white blobs concentrated on the distal-lateral tips of both lobes; the left lobe tip contains a more contiguous white patch extending approximately 20% inward, while the right lobe tip exhibits a more fragmented, speckled white-on-black pattern. The medial area surrounding the notch remains solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees; the lower vertex is partially obscured by hydro-dynamic spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Significant high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes, transitioning to smoother, lower-frequency variations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve sweeping upwards and outwards toward acute, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular high-contrast white pixels (potential barnacle attachment sites) are visible along the extreme edges of the trailing border, particularly on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged trailing edge topography suggests cumulative minor tissue loss or wear; distinct high-contrast white scarring is localized to the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water turbulence and spray occluding the lower medial boundary and peduncle attachment point.
